s3.contents: CAD files, drawings, PDF program sheets

primary_kpis.definition: Percentage of parts that pass QC inspection on the first attempt without rework
primary_kpis.numerator: Parts passing QC inspection on first attempt in period
source_tables_needed: orders (exists, links to customer and material)
missing_data: No QC inspection table exists anywhere in the system
No pass/fail outcome field in any existing table
No failure mode classification (dimensional, surface finish, feature missed, etc.)
production_count in InfluxDB is always 0 — cannot count parts from telemetry
No linkage from InfluxDB program_name to PostgreSQL order/part ID
primary_kpis.mvp_unblock_path: Create qc_inspection_results table in PostgreSQL. Capture: order_id, part_id, inspection_date, outcome (PASS/FAIL/CONDITIONAL), failure_mode, rework_cycle_number. Even a simple web form that writes to this table would unblock FPR.

primary_kpis.definition: Calendar days from job receipt (enquiry submitted) to AS9102 first article report submission to customer

stages.notes: submitted_at can be null. Use created_at as fallback. Live data on AWS only.
capp_service generates program sheets but does not write a completion timestamp to any DB. enquiry_parts.auto_quote_status has PENDING_PIPELINE/DRAFT/FINALIZED but no timestamp column.
No procurement module. No table for material purchase orders or goods receipt notes.

Can approximate from: last InfluxDB timestamp for a given program_name (when machine_state returns to 0 and program_name stops). Not stored explicitly. Linking InfluxDB program_name to PostgreSQL order requires manual naming convention.
No QC module. Same blocker as FPR.
No field or table tracks when AS9102 report was submitted to customer. Not tracked anywhere.
actual_delivery_date captures physical delivery, not customer sign-off on FAR. Partial proxy. Live on AWS only.

primary_kpis.computable_today: order_to_delivery_days = orders.actual_delivery_date - enquiries.submitted_at (2 of 7 stages captured, gives total elapsed time not FAR-specific timeline)
primary_kpis.mvp_unblock_path: Add capp_generated_at to enquiry_parts. Add qc_complete_at and far_submitted_at to orders. For material procurement, a simple date field on orders (material_received_date) would suffice at MVP.

computable_now.definition: Ratio of active cutting time to total machine-on time, per day
computable_now.notes: Both fields are non-zero in the data. Use cnc-data-v2 for program-level grouping.

computable_now.definition: Mean elapsed time (seconds) for one complete program cycle
computable_now.notes: cycle_time resets at program start. Use cnc-data-v2 where program_name is a tag. Significant variation across programs is expected (setups differ).

computable_now.definition: Percentage of telemetry samples showing an active alarm, per program
computable_now.notes: alarm_active is binary 0/1. High alarm rate for a program suggests setup or programming issues.

computable_now.definition: Mean and distribution of operator feed rate override percentage (100% = programmed value)
computable_now.notes: Override != 100 indicates manual adjustment. Frequent large deviations suggest CAPP parameters need calibration. Also applies to spindle_override.

computable_now.definition: Mean and peak spindle load during cutting per program
computable_now.formula: mean(spindle_load), max(spindle_load) where machine_state=1 grouped by program_name
computable_now.notes: Filter to machine_state=1 (running) to exclude idle readings. High peak load indicates tool wear or incorrect Vc.

computable_now.definition: Count of distinct programs started per calendar day
computable_now.formula: count(distinct program_name) per day where machine_state=1
computable_now.notes: Proxy for job throughput. Does not distinguish between setup programs and production runs.

computable_now.definition: Percentage of orders delivered on or before expected delivery date
computable_now.formula: count(actual_delivery_date <= expected_delivery_date) / count(orders with both dates) × 100
computable_now.notes: Schema exists. Requires live PostgreSQL data (AWS instance). Both date fields can be null — filter to rows where both are populated.

computable_now.definition: Percentage of enquiries that convert to confirmed orders
computable_now.notes: Schema exists. Requires live PostgreSQL data.

capture_gaps.gap_description: No QC inspection outcome captured anywhere — pass/fail, failure mode, rework cycle
capture_gaps.capture_method: New PostgreSQL table: qc_inspection_results(id, order_id, enquiry_part_id, inspector_id, inspected_at, outcome ENUM(PASS,FAIL,CONDITIONAL_PASS), failure_mode VARCHAR, rework_cycle INT, notes TEXT). Captured via: (a) internal web form in ShiaanX admin UI, or (b) webhook from CMM / inspection app.

capture_gaps.gap_description: production_count in InfluxDB is always 0 — CNC part counter not captured
capture_gaps.capture_method: Fix OPC UA / Focas data collection agent to map the correct part counter register from jyotiVMC controller. Likely a tag address mismatch in the data collection script.
capture_gaps.effort: Low — 1-line fix in OPC UA tag configuration

capture_gaps.gap_description: No timestamp for when CAPP program sheet was generated
capture_gaps.capture_method: Add capp_generated_at TIMESTAMP to enquiry_parts table. capp_service/runner.py writes this timestamp to PostgreSQL when program sheet PDF is created. One migration + 3-line change in runner.py.

capture_gaps.gap_description: No linkage between InfluxDB program_name and PostgreSQL order/part ID
capture_gaps.required_for_kpi: FAR cycle time (stage 4 — machining complete), FPR (part identity)
capture_gaps.capture_method: ProgramToolMappings table already exists but only maps program_name to tool. Extend it or create a new table: program_job_mappings(program_name, order_id, enquiry_part_id, scheduled_setup_number). Populated when CAPP generates a program sheet — the pipeline already knows the part and setup.

capture_gaps.gap_description: No AS9102 FAR report tracking — submission date, report ID, customer acknowledgement
capture_gaps.capture_method: New PostgreSQL table: far_reports(id, order_id, report_number VARCHAR, submitted_at TIMESTAMP, submitted_by UUID FK(users), s3_key VARCHAR, customer_acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP, notes TEXT). Captured via: admin form when FAR is sent to customer.
capture_gaps.effort: Medium — 1 table + 1 admin form + S3 upload

capture_gaps.gap_description: No material procurement tracking — purchase date, received date, material cert
capture_gaps.capture_method: Add to orders table: material_ordered_date DATE, material_received_date DATE. Or create separate procurement_records table for full traceability. Captured via: admin form or ERP integration.
capture_gaps.effort: Low (2 columns on orders) to Medium (full procurement table)

capture_gaps.gap_description: Telemetry data is stale — most recent data in cnc-data is 2026-05-13 (40 days old)
capture_gaps.required_for_kpi: All InfluxDB-based metrics (machine utilization, cycle time, etc.)
capture_gaps.capture_method: Investigate and restart the OPC UA / Focas data collection agent on jyotiVMC. cnc-data-v2 has more recent data (up to 2026-06-06) — check whether the collector was migrated to v2 or stopped. Dashboard queries should use cnc-data-v2 as primary bucket.
capture_gaps.effort: Low — operational fix, not code change

capture_gaps.gap_description: tool_name field stores G-code program text, not tool names — field name is misleading
capture_gaps.required_for_kpi: Tool utilization metrics, setup sheet validation
capture_gaps.capture_method: Option A: Fix OPC UA tag mapping to capture actual tool name string (if controller exposes it). Option B: Keep as G-code text (current state) and rely on parseGCode() for tool extraction — but rename the InfluxDB field to 'active_program_block' to avoid confusion. Option C: Use ProgramToolMappings in PostgreSQL as the tool reference.

proposed_schema_additions.rationale: Enables FPR computation. FPR = count(WHERE rework_cycle=1 AND outcome=PASS) / count(WHERE rework_cycle=1)

columns.s3_key: VARCHAR (S3 path to the PDF report)

proposed_schema_additions.rationale: Enables FAR cycle time stage 6. FAR submitted date is the official end point of the AS9102 timeline.
Links InfluxDB telemetry to PostgreSQL orders. Enables machining_complete derivation from InfluxDB program end time. CAPP pipeline populates this at program sheet generation time.

columns.machining_started_at: TIMESTAMP (derived from InfluxDB or manual entry)
columns.machining_completed_at: TIMESTAMP (derived from InfluxDB or manual entry)

proposed_schema_additions.rationale: Captures FAR cycle time stages 2 and 4 at the part level.
